/obj/item/clothing/neck/beads/vow_ring.name: iron vow ring
/obj/item/clothing/neck/beads/vow_ring.note: A linked pair: once both are worn, either wearer can speak the vow, which locks both rings on (no drop) and lets each examine their own ring to read the partner's direction, distance and health. Afterward the ring pulls up to 30 of the partner's brute, then burn, damage onto the user, 30 second cooldown. The vow ends if either wearer dies or lets go.
/obj/item/clothing/neck/beads/vow_ring.reason: Authored unique pair. Two wearers bind: each can find the other and read their health, and pull up to 30 of their brute or burn onto themselves every 30 seconds.

/obj/item/clothing/neck/chameleon.name: black tie
/obj/item/clothing/neck/chameleon.reason: A disguise tie with some fire and acid resistance. Gives nothing the ties it copies would.

/obj/item/clothing/neck/cloak/cap.name: captain's cloak
/obj/item/clothing/neck/cloak/cap.reason: A ship officer's cloak. No armor, looks only. A surgeon can drape a patient with it.

/obj/item/clothing/neck/cloak/herald_clo.name: cloak of the prophet
/obj/item/clothing/neck/cloak/herald_clo.note: Each hit on the wearer has an 80% chance (the code skips on a 20% roll) of firing eight bolts in a ring one second later. Each bolt does 20 brute with 60 armour penetration, passes over tables, digs through rock and does no damage to mobs sharing the wearer's faction. There is no cooldown.
/obj/item/clothing/neck/cloak/herald_clo.reason: Herald trophy. Most hits on you fire a ring of 8 armor-piercing bolts at 20 damage, with no cooldown. The bolts do nothing to anyone sharing your faction, which means other crews, so this is pure NPC-fighting gear.

/obj/item/clothing/neck/cloak/skill_rewa.name: legendary veteran's cloak
/obj/item/clothing/neck/cloak/skill_rewa.reason: A reward cloak that veteran players can choose to spawn in. Can't be destroyed, has no armor, does nothing.

/obj/item/clothing/neck/collar_bomb.name: collar bomb
/obj/item/clothing/neck/collar_bomb.note: Once worn on the neck it can't be taken off. A remote button (1.2 second press) or pulsing its wire starts a 5 second countdown, then it deals 200 brute to the head and decapitates the wearer; it fizzles if the collar is no longer worn on a human neck by then. The wearer can't open the wire panel, cutting the wire does nothing and EMPs don't set it off.
/obj/item/clothing/neck/collar_bomb.reason: Lock it on a captive and a button takes their head off 5 seconds later. It stays on. A hostage tool, no help in a fight. Black market only, 700 to 900 cr.

/obj/item/clothing/neck/link_scryer.name: MODlink scryer
/obj/item/clothing/neck/link_scryer.note: A neck video-phone: calls another MODlink (scryer or MODsuit) on the same frequency, showing a hologram of each person to the other and relaying the wearer's speech nearby. It needs a power cell, which drains during a call, and a frequency set with a multitool; the base unit comes with neither. The call ends if it comes off the neck, the cell empties or the wearer dies.
/obj/item/clothing/neck/link_scryer.reason: A video phone on a necklace. Needs a cell and a frequency. A radio does the useful part.

/obj/item/clothing/neck/link_scryer/load.name: MODlink scryer
/obj/item/clothing/neck/link_scryer/load.note: A neck video-phone: calls another MODlink (scryer or MODsuit) on the same frequency, showing a hologram of each person to the other and relaying the wearer's speech nearby. It needs a power cell, which drains during a call, and a frequency set with a multitool; the base unit comes with neither. The call ends if it comes off the neck, the cell empties or the wearer dies.
/obj/item/clothing/neck/link_scryer/load.reason: A video phone on a necklace, set up for one fixed frequency. Found in four ruins. A radio does the useful part.

/obj/item/clothing/neck/night_sisters_wa.name: night sister's watch
/obj/item/clothing/neck/night_sisters_wa.note: While worn it scans every four seconds and sends the wearer a message with a compass direction whenever any other living mob on the same z-level (crew or not) newly drops into hard crit.
/obj/item/clothing/neck/night_sisters_wa.reason: Authored unique. Gives the direction of anyone on your deck who drops into hard crit, friend or foe. Great for a medic, or a hunter.

/obj/item/clothing/neck/petcollar.name: pet collar
/obj/item/clothing/neck/petcollar.note: Can only be worn by monkeys. Using it in hand sets a name tag; no other effect.
/obj/item/clothing/neck/petcollar.reason: Only monkeys can wear it. It holds a name tag.

/obj/item/clothing/neck/pillow_tag.name: pillow tag
/obj/item/clothing/neck/pillow_tag.reason: The price tag off a pillow. Does nothing.

/obj/item/clothing/neck/scarf/purple/con.name: confessor's stole
/obj/item/clothing/neck/scarf/purple/con.note: While worn, whatever living creature the wearer is pulling gets pacifism for as long as the pull lasts: they can't attack but can still talk, struggle and walk away. It lifts when the wearer lets go or takes the stole off.
/obj/item/clothing/neck/scarf/purple/con.reason: Authored unique. Anyone you're pulling can't attack for as long as you hold them, though they can still pull away.

/obj/item/clothing/neck/stethoscope.name: stethoscope
/obj/item/clothing/neck/stethoscope.note: Used on a human out of combat mode, it reports by the targeted zone: chest gives breathing and heartbeat, groin gives liver and appendix state, head or limbs give pulse; eyes and mouth are refused and the user must be able to hear. Wearing it also lowers fishing difficulty by 3.
/obj/item/clothing/neck/stethoscope.reason: Listens to a patient's lungs, heart and liver. A health analyzer tells you more. Prints for almost nothing.

method: No formula. Almost everything here is cosmetic, so the work is finding the few that do something and placing those against other categories' anchors. Authored uniques are above.
